mapper.select: SELECT id FROM managed_resource WHERE id = #{resourceId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, managed_resource_id, policy_key, name, version_no, criteria_schema_name, criteria_schema_version, criteria_payload, activated_at FROM recovery_policy WHERE managed_resource_id = #{resourceId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) FROM recovery_policy WHERE managed_resource_id = #{resourceId} AND policy_key = CAST(#{policyKey} AS BINARY)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recovery_policy (managed_resource_id, policy_key, name, version_no, criteria_schema_name, criteria_schema_version, criteria_payload, status, created_at, activated_at) VALUES (#{policy.managedResourceId}, #{policy.policyKey}, #{policy.name}, #{policy.versionNo}, #{policy.criteriaSchemaName}, #{policy.criteriaSchemaVersion}, #{policy.criteriaPayload}, 'ACTIVE', #{policy.at}, #{policy.at})
